with chave as (
  select upper(encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(6), 'hex')) as valor
),
novo_usuario as (
  insert into public.users (telegram_id, first_name, username, access_key_hash)
  select $1::bigint, $2::text, $3::text,
         extensions.crypt(chave.valor, extensions.gen_salt('bf', 10))
  from chave
  on conflict (telegram_id) do nothing
  returning id, first_name, created_at
)
select novo_usuario.id,
       novo_usuario.first_name,
       chave.valor as access_key
from novo_usuario, chave;

with alvos as (
  select trim(n)::integer as numero
  from unnest(string_to_array($2::text, ',')) as n
  where trim(n) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
)
delete from public.tasks t
where t.user_id = $1::uuid
  and t.numero in (select numero from alvos)
returning t.numero, t.title;

with alvos as (
  select trim(n)::integer as numero
  from unnest(string_to_array($2::text, ',')) as n
  where trim(n) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
)
update public.tasks t
set status = 'concluida'
where t.user_id = $1::uuid
  and t.numero in (select numero from alvos)
  and t.status <> 'concluida'
returning t.numero, t.title;

select numero, title, status, priority, category, due_date
from public.tasks
where user_id = $1::uuid
  and status not in ('concluida', 'cancelada')
order by
  case priority
    when 'urgente' then 1
    when 'alta'    then 2
    when 'media'   then 3
    else 4
  end,
  numero
limit 30;

with entrada as (
  select $1::uuid as user_id,
         left(nullif(trim($2::text), ''), 200) as title,
         nullif(trim($3::text), '') as category,
         $4::public.task_priority as priority,
         $5::boolean as ai_processed
),
proximo as (
  select coalesce(max(t.numero), 0) + 1 as numero
  from public.tasks t, entrada e
  where t.user_id = e.user_id
)
insert into public.tasks (user_id, numero, title, category, priority, ai_processed)
select e.user_id, p.numero, e.title, e.category, e.priority, e.ai_processed
from entrada e, proximo p
where e.title is not null
returning numero, title, category, priority;
